name: ehoeho
description: えほえほ web app and Android APK build

scripts.android:init: npm run web:build && npx cap add android
scripts.android:sync: npm run web:build && npx cap sync android
scripts.android:release: npm run android:sync && npx cap build android --androidreleasetype APK
scripts.android:open: npm run android:sync && npx cap open android
scripts.android:run: npm run android:sync && npx cap run android
